senses.gloss:
दोष दोष, i. e. दुष् + अ, m.
 1. Defect, blemish, Hariv. 2108; Man. 8, 205.
 2. Fault, vice, MBh. 5, 1048.
 3. Damage, Yājñ. 2, 256.
 4. Sin, Man. 5, 3.
 5. Crime, Man. 9, 262.
 6. Reproach, Rām. 2, 101, 32 Gorr.; दोषेण [] गम्, To accuse, Chr. 16, 14.
 7. Detrimental operation, Kathās. 13, 35.
 8. Effect, Rām. 3, 79, 25.
 9. Disorder of the humours of the body, or defect in the functions of bile, phlegm, and wind, Suśr. 2, 562, 4.
 10. The humours of the body, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 4.
 11. Evening, darkness, Bhāg. P. 6, 8, 19.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. δειελός, δείλη.
दोषा दोषा, an old instr. of दोष, adv. At night, Śiś. 4, 46.

दोषतस् दोष + तस्, adv.
 1. Of a transgression (viz. to suspect), Nal. 23, 28.
 2. By the detrimental effect of something, Kathās. 13, 33.
दोषल दोष + ल, adj., f. ला, Corrupt, Suśr. 1, 173, 18.

दोषवन्त् दोष + वन्त्, adj., f. वती.
 1. Blemished, Man. 8, 224.
 2. Deficient, MBh. 12, 8037.
 3. Guilty, MBh. 13, 57.
 4. Detrimental, Rām. 5, 90, 26.
 --Comp.
दोषातन दोषा + तन, adj., f. नी, Nocturnal, at evening, Ragh. 13, 76.
दोषिन् दोषिन्, i. e. दोष + न्, adj. Becoming defiled, Mārk. P. 31, 21.
दोस् दोस् (the base of many cases is दोषन्), n. The fore-arm, Rām. 3, 35, 78.
